name: cx-box
task: Carry the box to the exit, and whenever the box falls, pick it up again.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The hard Response(box_fell, holding_box) does not capture “pick it up again.” It allows the box to be picked up on the same step it falls, while the task requires picking it up afterward. Use a rule that requires a later pickup after each fall; the current Response clause is too weak.

CHANGES REQUIRED: `Response(box_fell, holding_box)` only requires carrying the box on some later step, not picking it up again after every fall. The task says to pick it up again whenever it falls, so replace this with `ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box)`, which requires carrying it on the very next step.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) and Response(at_exit, holding_box) require reaching the exit while carrying the box. ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) requires picking the box up again on the next step after each fall.

texts: Reach the exit while carrying the box.
Be carrying the box when reaching the exit.
Whenever the box falls, be carrying it again on the next step.
